hooks.command:
cat <<'MSG'
[Discovery] Product discovery practices are active. Before planning or scoping:
  1. Load the relevant discovery skill (see CLAUDE.md router table)
  2. Frame the problem before jumping to solutions (discovery-framing)
  3. Identify your users (persona-framing)
  4. Define outcomes, not outputs (outcome-over-output)
MSG
echo '[Discovery] Before writing — is this grounded in a persona? Is there a discovery skill loaded? Stories without a named user are solutions looking for a problem.'
echo '[Discovery] If creating issues/stories: tied to an outcome, not just an output? If scoping: sliced thin enough to learn from?'
echo '[Discovery] Checkpoint — did you: (1) load a discovery skill? (2) name the persona? (3) define the outcome? (4) slice thin? If not, revisit before finalizing.'
